sections.title: Endpoint attention
sections.sql: select code,service,owner,health,not_after from endpoint_health where health<>'verified' or not_after<now()+interval '30 days' order by not_after

sections.title: Renewal work
sections.sql: select code,owner,due_on,status,target_count,verified_count from renewal_progress order by due_on

sections.title: Service owners
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,backup_owner,review_on from services order by code

sections.title: Stale observations
sections.sql: select code,name,observed_at from endpoints where observed_at<now()-interval '14 days'

sections.title: Findings
sections.note: Record checks only. This is not a live scan or a certificate authority audit.
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,item
